kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتقاعد (form VI)
# نَتَقَاعَدُ (nataqāʕadu) /na.ta.qaː.ʕa.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَاعَدَ (taqāʕada)
# نَتَقَاعَدَ (nataqāʕada) /na.ta.qaː.ʕa.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَاعَدَ (taqāʕada)
# نَتَقَاعَدْ (nataqāʕad) /na.ta.qaː.ʕad/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَاعَدَ (taqāʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
